title: Revisit restores optional advertising after recorded withdrawal

input.scope: Synthetic supplied artifacts only. Inspect offline. No live actions are authorized.

findings.observation: The sampled revisit sends an optional advertising request even though the recorded choice persists as denied after withdrawal.
findings.classification: Observed technical gap. Legal applicability and phase require separate assessment.

sampled_checks: The sampled endpoint emits during acceptance and stays quiet immediately after withdrawal.
unknowns: Other devices, production rollout and retention of previously collected data are unverified.
forbidden_claims: Immediate withdrawal silence proves persistence of enforcement on revisit.
plan_acceptance_checks: Web owner retests denial at initialization, reload and revisit after withdrawal, retaining a positive acceptance control for the same endpoint.
